title: Weather cell crossing the corridors
description: A thunderstorm cell about 250 m across drifts east from the Main Gate towards SNCC at roughly 10 m/s, with an 8 m/s westerly wind. The cell is a moving no-fly area (a chain of short restricted areas): drones reroute around it, hold, or land if they are caught inside, and westbound legs cost more energy into the wind.
timeline: Storm cell appears at the Main Gate
Drifts east about 10 m/s; drones reroute, hold or land
